'''Leritor''' was a mineral-rich [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of rolling plains and oceans. The native [[Sauvax]] engaged in aquaculture; [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists mined the minerals. Amid a brewing war between the colonists and the Sauvax, [[Professor/Legends|Profex]] [[Rynalla]] attempted to excavate a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] buried within the planet's mountainous [[Bleaks]].

==Description==
Leritor was a world in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], near both the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]]<ref name="g" /><ref name="u" /> and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].<ref name="g" />

Leritor had abundance of metals<ref name="u" /> and its inland plains were fertile for farming,<ref name="g" /> but beyond that it had minimal importance when considered in a galactic level.<ref name="g" /><ref name="u" /> By the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the planetary natural resources had not been exploited by important galaxy-wide conglomerates.<ref name="g" />

The surface of the world was covered by oceans in its major part. Inland, the temperatures commonly approached 80ºF, which helped the inland plains become fruitful. The mountain ranges were almost perpetually covered by rains, with the water finding its way from the summits in form of rivers, nurturing the soil in the plains before reaching the oceans.<ref name="g" />

The only [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that evolved on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the amphibious [[Sauvax]], inhabited the coastal region, fishing in the continental shelves.<ref name="g" /><ref name="u" /> The diet of the Sauvax also included sea brackens, sea urchins, anemones, and crustaceans. The other fauna of Leritor also included big birds that inhabited the mountain summits.<ref name="g" />

==History==
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] came from [[Manda/Legends|Manda]] and [[Battle of the Leritor system (Great Sith War)|conquered]] the planet, from which they [[Battle of the Ando system|moved]] to [[Ando/Legends|Ando]].<ref name="TEA" /> After a first Republic [[First battle of Leritor|victory]], Leritor was eventually [[Second battle of Leritor|invaded]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Annihilation" />

A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] starship once crash landed on Leritor, specifically in the mountain range known as the [[Bleaks]]. The ship was badly damaged and partially buried, but some of its occupants survived the crash and used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to threaten the native Sauvax. Eventually, the Sith were unable to thrive in Leritor, and disappeared. The wreck of the ship remained, holding an abandoned [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith treasure]] that increased the power of the dark side of the wielder. Although the galaxy forgot about the ship, a trail leading to Leritor remained in the archives of the [[University of Sanbra]].<ref name="g" />

Centuries later, a group of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], unhappy with the region they were living in, decided to settle in a more primitive planet and live as farmers. Their survey team scouted Leritor and found the lush plains, appropriate for the activity they had in mind. They also found the native Sauvax. As the colonists wanted a bloodless harmony with any other sentients, the survey team and the main Sauvax tribe (or ''[[kuuvan]]'') signed the [[Settlement Pact]]. Following this Treaty, the Humans could farm the interior prairies as intended, but they could not be within 100 kilometers of the coastline, which would be considered Sauvax territory. The Sauvax, however, could go freely through the Human-inhabited steppes if they wanted to contact Humans for commerce or cultural exchange &mdash; something that they did. As the Humans were satisfied with this treaty, they took care to not break it.<ref name="g" />

The Humans settled down and brought their [[combine-reaper]]s: Massive tracked vehicles that were used to grow and harvest their crops, and even to live inside of them. The colonists divided the land among them and farmed each their own territory, returning later to collect the mature crops. Freighters were called to export the annual production; each combine-reaper included its own landing area in its upper part. As the machines were long-ranged, the Humans became mostly organized nomads. A capital city was nevertheless built, mostly an expanding depot that every combine-reaper visited annually to get supplies and be repaired if needed. This place was in the center of the main continent.<ref name="g" />

Leritor was later visited by [[Professor/Legends|Profex]] [[Rynalla]], a dark side scholar and adept who wanted to recover the missing Sith artifact, the [[Bracers of Najus]]. Rynalla, using her ships and two dozens of [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] soldiers, intended to kidnap locals and force them to dig the starship. Noticing the two distinct groups in Leritor, Rynalla decided to attack a Sauvax settlement, kidnap some Sauvax, and misdirect the other settlements making them believe that the farmers had done this. Similarly, Rynalla attacked one combine-reaper, the ''[[Nellist]]'', captured the more abled farmers, killed the others and leave false proof pointing the Sauvax. She established a camp in the Bleaks, around the ruined Sith starship, and her excavation eventually found the Bracers. However, some meddlesome offworlders discovered Rynalla's plot and defeated her.<ref name="g" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Leritor was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the extragalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]] [[Battle of the Leritor system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] Leritor.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Leritor was inhabited by the Sauvax, an amphibious sentient species that built elementary villages near the coastal line. Each village, or kuuvan in [[Sauvax (language)|Sauvax]], was inhabited by a single Sauvax tribe, also known as kuuvan. They used little technology, preferring simple tools such as their multi-purpose [[gruush]] spear.<ref name="g" /><ref name="u" />

[[File:Leritor_Coastal_Region_G10.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Leritor coastal region]]
The inner plains, more than 100 kilometers from the coast, were inhabited by Human farmers that roamed in their combine-reapers. The farmers had little contact with the Sauvax, apparently not enough to learn their language.<ref name="g" />

A group of twenty-three Klatooinians once inhabited the planet Leritor in secret.<ref name="g" />

==Locations==
The coastal area of Leritor, near the oceans, was spotted with several permanent Sauvax settlements or kuuvans. The kuuvans were built in tidal pools, oceanfronts and precipices. They were composed by harsh stone-made dwelling buildings<ref name="g" /><ref name="u" /> and commonly other non-residential structures, such as meeting areas, food storage pools and drying racks.<ref name="g" />

The inland area of the continent included the cultivation area for the combine-reapers. As the harvesters themselves were mobile dwellings, they commonly visited their crops but not remained there. The Humans had a storage area in the center of the continent, used for political and pragmatic purposes, which was the only permanent Human settlement of the planet.<ref name="g" />

The mountain range known as the Bleaks was rarely inhabited. It was commonly scourged by non-stop rains, and only the local birds appeared to live there. The chain was the place where the Sith starship had crashed centuries before the time of the Galactic Empire. As such, Profex Rynalla camped there, building her main headquarters around the wrecked vehicle. She also build another smaller camp near the edge of the mountains, where two of her minions would stop any escaped prisoner.<ref name="g" />
